integrity: Fully self-contained proof and verification program are provided; no independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only an explicitly constructed absolutely continuous stationary pair measure is studied; uniqueness of stationary laws is not asserted.
Integer equal expansion/contraction base, uniform inverse-branch probabilities, common random driver, and Euclidean coordinate distance are essential assumptions.
The literary novelty comparison is limited to inspected accessible primary materials; an unindexed parallel calculation cannot be excluded.
Finite algebraic checks corroborate, but do not prove, the statements involving all scales or infinite limits.
title: Exact near-diagonal probability and logarithmic lattice phases for randomly driven affine interval pairs
